breaking.change: Removed -og-enter and -og-exit, including their reflected enter/exit attributes.
breaking.fix: Use @starting-style with standard transitions for entrances. Exit with opacity and display transitions using allow-discrete, keeping the element mounted until its display becomes none. Svelte in:/out:/transition: directives retain their existing lifecycle behavior.

fixed.summary: data-og-instant settles the first @starting-style entrance for channel and computed values. Whitespace no longer makes a discrete display exit disappear halfway through; retained display exits retire their render subtree on completion.
